decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the map.apps ecosystem and is likely folded into the standard bundles, but its absence from the website since 2019 suggests declining visibility.
This niche search plugin has not been visible since 2018 and may be absorbed or retired, but it costs little to maintain within the map.apps platform.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship and strategic focus, so it remains central even if its branding on the website changed.
Field data capture remains a core need for utility and public customers, though platform-vendor mobile apps increasingly compete with the firm's own solution.
